name: Japhia
title: The King of Lachish
summary: Japhia was the king of Lachish, one of the five Amorite kings who formed an alliance against Gibeon after the Gibeonites had made a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. He was defeated and killed by Joshua during the conquest of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Alliance Against Gibeon
keyEvents.description: Japhia joined a coalition of five Amorite kings led by Adoni-Zedek, the king of Jerusalem, to attack Gibeon because the Gibeonites had made peace with Israel.

keyEvents.title: Gibeon's Call for Help
keyEvents.description: The Gibeonites sent word to Joshua and asked for help against the five kings who were besieging their city, including Japhia of Lachish.

keyEvents.title: The Lord's Intervention in the Battle
keyEvents.description: God threw the Amorite armies into confusion and sent hail upon them as they fled, so that more died from the hail than from the swords of the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: The Five Kings Hide in a Cave at Makkedah
keyEvents.description: Japhia and the other four kings fled and hid in a cave at Makkedah, but they were discovered and captured.

keyEvents.title: The Execution of Japhia
keyEvents.description: Joshua ordered that the five kings, including Japhia, be brought out of the cave. He humiliated them and then killed them, hanging them on five trees as a sign of God's judgment.

keyEvents.title: The Conquest of Lachish
keyEvents.description: After Japhia's death, Joshua conquered the city of Lachish and struck it with the edge of the sword, just as the Lord had given it into Israel's hands.
